title: PNP reports P3.4-M haul from La Union drug busts in a week
summary: SAN FERNANDO CITY, La Union – The Ilocos Regional Police’s campaign against illegal drugs led to the confiscation of P3.4 million worth of suspected shabu and marijuana plants, during crime…

blocks.text: SAN FERNANDO CITY, La Union – The Ilocos Regional Police’s campaign against illegal drugs led to the confiscation of P3.4 million worth of suspected shabu and marijuana plants, during crime suppression operations conducted from September 1-7.

A police report showed that it conducted 25 operations during which they arrested 24 suspects in possession of 411.48 grams of suspected shabu, 2,740 fully grown marijuana plants, 1,400 marijuana seedlings, and 30 grams of dried marijuana leaves.
The intensified manhunt operations also secured the arrest of 56 fugitives, including seven most wanted persons (MWPs) and 49 other wanted suspects, the report said.
The police’s 20 operations against illegal gambling also led to the arrest of 20 suspects and the confiscation of bet money amounting to P33,457.00.
The drive against loose firearms likewise accounted for nine weapons, consisting of six surrendered and three deposited firearms.

“Our weekly accomplishments reflect the police’s commitment to responsive and effective law enforcement. We will remain relentless in our operations and steadfast in safeguarding the peace, safety, and security of communities across the Ilocos Region,” said Brig. Gen. Crisaleo Tolentino, Ilocos police director, in a statement.
The Ilocos Region is composed of the provinces of Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, La Union and Pangasinan. /jpv
